Good afternoon,
Our service partner attended on-site to replace the contactors.
We waited a few days before closing the ticket, as another issue related to the PLC arose.
Yesterday, we managed to restore full operations and everything is now functioning correctly, allowing us to proceed with the closure of the ticket.
Please find the intervention report attached.
